pages.text: Charges a jar standing on it, 500 FE/t, from the 20 kFE it holds.

In your body, set your head on it from the Head Satchel: it charges there too.$(br2)Feed it from a source beside it. A pile alone gives 20 FE/t; a Leyden Jar keeps it stocked.$(br2)$(o)DOLORES notes: wipe your jar first.$()
